case_name: Keith Thaete, Steve King, Lance Thaete v. St. Luke's Magic Valley Center, Michael R. Fry, D.O

issues.label: Service of notice of appeal jurisdictional
issues.why: Court must decide whether failure to serve the notice of appeal deprives the appellate court of jurisdiction.

issues.label: Timeliness/adequacy of appeal filing
issues.why: Whether the notice was properly filed satisfying appellate prerequisites even absent service.

issues.label: Abuse of discretion striking filings
issues.why: Whether striking the August 28-29 filings satisfied the four-part Lunneborg test.

issues.label: Untimeliness of rebuttal filings
issues.why: Whether the August 28-29 filings violated the amended August 22 response deadline.

issues.label: Improper rebuttal designation
issues.why: Whether opinions rebutting a dispositive motion on plaintiffs' case-in-chief were properly designated as rebuttal.

issues.label: Prejudice from new standard-of-care opinions
issues.why: Whether late opinions introduced new theories that unfairly prejudiced Respondents.

issues.label: Dr. McIlraith foundation under 6-1012/6-1013
issues.why: Whether McIlraith demonstrated actual knowledge of the applicable community standard of care.

issues.label: Effect of shared board certification
issues.why: Whether shared board certification alone establishes familiarity with the local standard of care.

issues.label: Sufficiency of Dr. Fry deposition foundation
issues.why: Whether Fry's deposition provided adequate detail to ground McIlraith's community-standard opinion.

issues.label: Nurse Chisum breach opinion adequacy
issues.why: Whether Chisum's disclosure contained an admissible breach-of-standard opinion.

issues.label: Chisum unwillingness to testify
issues.why: Whether counsel's representations that Chisum would not testify bar reliance on her opinions.

issues.label: Nurse Tripp disclosure timeliness
issues.why: Whether Tripp's supplemental disclosure violated the amended scheduling order.

issues.label: Admissibility as threshold, no liberal construction
issues.why: Court must apply the non-liberal admissibility standard before assessing genuine factual disputes.

issues.label: Prima facie medical malpractice without experts
issues.why: Whether plaintiffs can survive summary judgment absent admissible expert testimony.

issues.label: Summary judgment standard under Rule 56(a)
issues.why: Whether there remains any genuine dispute of material fact entitling movants to judgment.

issues.label: Local vs national standard of care
issues.why: Whether the Twin Falls community standard was properly established by plaintiffs' experts.

issues.label: Causation of Sherry Thaete's death
issues.why: Whether the contraindicated Paxil administration proximately caused death, requiring expert proof.

issues.label: Dr. Fry's actual knowledge of Nardil
issues.why: Conflicting testimony on Fry's awareness bears on breach and creates factual disputes.

issues.label: Hospital vicarious/direct liability standard
issues.why: Whether St. Luke's liability requires separate expert foundation on nursing/institutional standards.

issues.label: Negligence per se and reckless conduct labels
issues.why: Whether the alternately-labeled claims still fall entirely under the Medical Malpractice Act.

issues.label: Denial of reconsideration standard
issues.why: Whether the district court properly reevaluated its rulings on the reconsideration motion.

issues.label: Motion to compel/discovery adequacy
issues.why: Whether discovery limitations on policy documents impaired plaintiffs' ability to prove their case.

issues.label: Attorney fees entitlement on appeal
issues.why: Court must determine whether either party is entitled to attorney fees.

issues.label: Effect of scheduling order amendments
issues.why: Which disclosure deadlines controlled given the twice-amended scheduling order.

issues.label: Motion to extend response deadline scope
issues.why: Whether the extension order altered rebuttal-disclosure deadlines relevant to the stricken filings.
